# Evercraft Website Launch Service

Capability ID: website-launch-service-v1
Commercial state: migration_hold
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/website-launch-service-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- build me a business website
- launch a website for my company
- replace my bad website
- make me a professional business site
- handle my website for me

## Problem

A business needs a professional website built or upgraded without operating a site-builder interface.

## Inputs

Choose one verified service tier and provide customer name/email, business name and a useful project brief. Current website and phone are optional.

## Outputs

A bounded paid website-service order and completed website/service outcome through the existing fulfillment workflow.

## Pricing

Human-Finished Pro Site $500 one-time; Premium Custom Build $999 one-time; Total Business Launch $1,999 one-time.

- Human-Finished Pro Site: $500 (one_time)

- Premium Custom Build: $999 (one_time)

- Total Business Launch: $1,999 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

The buyer must explicitly choose a tier and confirm payment before checkout. Fulfillment begins only after independent payment verification.

Payment authority: Evercraft Website Service / Stripe, provider-verified

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
